visualReview.summary: The complete regenerated waving row removes the duplicate lowered sleeve from the raised-arm poses while retaining Maeril's identity and a steady desktop-size greeting loop.
notes: Both raised-arm frames show exactly one raised screen-left arm and one resting screen-right arm; no extra sleeve remains behind the screen-left hip.
The two raised-hand poses have a visible hand-angle change, with stable torso and foot placement.
Reviewed at 192 by 208 pixels on dark, light, and blue-gray backgrounds, plus a timed animated comparison.
No opaque white holes, shadows, or stray debris were visible.
Accepted minor differences: cleaner outlines, slightly warmer gold details, and small head/robe contour changes. The independent review found no conspicuous identity, style, or color pop from idle.
All other animation rows and sixteen look directions retain their exact v1.0.1 decoded pixels.
